nameOrigin: transport an item to the recipient

pokedexEntries.go: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

pokedexEntries.si: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

pokedexEntries.cr: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.
